scopeNote: integration contract: Pure-Swift client (PyricMessaging) conforming to FirebaseMessaging via the Pyric WebSocket bridge and MessagingBroker. Covers per-app Messaging singletons and multi-app isolation, deterministic 142-character :APA91b FCM token minting and MessagingDelegate notifications, retrieveFCMToken/deleteFCMToken multi-sender tokens, deleteToken invalidation and rotation, local MessagingTopicValidator checks and boolean-condition/validateOnly sendBrokerMessage fanout, visible/hidden foregroundMessages and backgroundMessages AsyncStreams, direct deliver() injection, appDidReceiveMessage and BigQuery delivery metrics export, and MessagingError CustomNSError mapping.
